1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the alignment device dynamically tracks a progression through multiple steps of the documented procedure by continuously comparing the demonstrated user actions against expected document actions for each step__.

2. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by analyzing real-time user interface interactions and matching them to corresponding steps in the documented procedure__.

3. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __based on semantic analysis of user interface elements and document content__.

4. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification __using visual indicators that distinguish between completed, current, and upcoming procedural steps__.

5. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by predicting upcoming user actions based on the computed alignment and procedural flow__.

6. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __through predictive analysis of user workflow patterns__.

7. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification __using contextual visual cues that adapt to user performance__.

9. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure __and further includes semantic matching of user interface control types with procedural action descriptions__.

10. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment __by performing image analysis to identify specific user interface elements and user interactions therewith__.

11. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __by maintaining a learning model that adapts similarity metrics based on historical user performance data__.

12. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps __and parsing procedural text to identify actionable elements and their sequential relationships__.

13. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that includes semantic analysis of procedural content and real-time user interface state__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device.

15. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment __by analyzing visual elements within the captured images to identify user interface components and user interactions__.

16. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __using machine learning algorithms that adapt to individual user behavior patterns__.

17. (Currently Amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that includes real-time analysis of user interface state changes and semantic matching with procedural step descriptions__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __by correlating observed user interface interactions with expected actions for each procedural step__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface __based on contextual analysis of user interface elements and document structure__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __through predictive modeling of user workflow progression__.

21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface __using adaptive prediction algorithms__.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure __and includes semantic analysis of user interface control types and their correspondence to procedural actions__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device __through computer vision analysis of user interface elements and user interactions within the captured images__.

25. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __using adaptive learning algorithms that personalize similarity metrics based on historical user behavior__.

26. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure __through natural language processing to identify actionable procedural elements__.

27. (Currently Amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17.

28. (Currently Amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric __that performs semantic analysis of procedural content and real-time monitoring of user interface state changes__; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment.

30. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device __through image processing to identify and track user interface elements and user interactions therewith__.

31. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure __using machine learning models that adapt to individual user performance characteristics__.

32. (Currently Amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28.
